images.alt: A missing game has three different checks. ELIGIBILITY: Can this title be shared?. COPY AVAILABILITY: Is a family copy available?. LOCAL INSTALLATION: Can this PC run it?
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: Owned copies and simultaneous play. ONE OWNED COPY: One person uses that title. ANOTHER FAMILY TITLE: A different game may be available. SECOND OWNED COPY: Can provide another playable copy
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: Prepare a useful support report. IDENTIFY: Title, edition and account role. CAPTURE: Exact message and time. COMPARE: Missing entry or failed launch?
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: Footage, clip and exported file. RECORD: Capture the gameplay session. SAVE A CLIP: Select the moment to keep. EXPORT: Create a shareable video file
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: A storage budget has several parts. BACKGROUND BUFFER: Temporary rolling footage. SAVED CLIPS: Moments you retain. EXPORTED VIDEOS: Files stored in a chosen folder
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: Test the audio before the match. GAME SOUND: Is the game audible?. MICROPHONE: Is your voice intended?. OTHER AUDIO: Could private chat be included?
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: Before you lose the connection. UPDATE: Complete client and game setup. LAUNCH: Open each intended game. TEST OFFLINE: Verify the real travel setup
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: Three separate offline questions. STEAM CLIENT: Can this client enter Offline Mode?. THE GAME: Does this title need a connection?. SAVE DATA: Is the intended progress local?
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial

images.alt: When you reconnect. WAIT: Let synchronisation finish. READ: Inspect any conflict message. PRESERVE: Protect the progress you intend to keep
images.creator: GAMIC News Editorial
